Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20 minute sync if that's easier.

Emily — quick additions from the security/procurement playbook side to reduce back-and-forth. Please treat this as our suggested minimal evidence bundle for procurement to accept the expansion PO without extended review: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — required.
- Signed bridge letter on company letterhead (PDF via DocuSign) — required if report coverage ends before Oct 1.
- SOC 2 scope statement (one-paragraph) — clarifies which services are in-scope.
- User access & change control screenshots (redacted examples) — two or three screenshots that map to user provisioning and change management controls.
- Data flow diagram (sanitized) — shows where PHI/PII touches the system if relevant.
- Incident response summary (one-pager) — not detailed IR artifacts, just the process and SLAs.
- Link to our CAIQ export / SIG stub — available on request; typically provided within 48 hours from acceptance.

Attachments: the initial bundle Markus mentioned. If your procurement team needs a single procurement packet (PDF + checklist) let us know and we'll compile it.

Proposed next steps: 
- Emily to confirm PO cutoff date (you mentioned Aug 20).
- Redwood to deliver the bundle as a single zip + DocuSign link for the bridge no later than Aug 6 (target).
- If MediCore security requests live screens or a 30-minute walkthrough, we can schedule Aug 9–11.

Calendars: I have windows Aug 9 10–11am PT, Aug 10 2–3pm PT. Emily — which works best for your reviewers?
